title: Mission 3 — Weekend in Jūrmala
summary: Take the electric train to Jūrmala, chat with a friendly neighbour on the beach, and ask the waiter for fish at a Majori café.
summary_lv: Aizbrauc ar elektrovilcienu uz Jūrmalu, parunājies pludmalē ar laipnu kaimiņieni un pasūti zivi Majoru kafejnīcā.

scenes.title: Small talk on the beach
scenes.instruction: Introduce yourself to Līga on the beach. Tell her where you are from.
scenes.instruction_lv: Iepazīsties ar Līgu pludmalē. Pasaki, no kurienes tu esi.

scenes.title: Talk about the weather
scenes.instruction: Talk with Līga about the weather and her weekend plans.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pārrunā ar Līgu laikapstākļus un viņas nedēļas nogales plānus.

scenes.title: Order grilled fish
scenes.instruction: Order grilled fish and a glass of water from the waiter Jānis.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pasūti pie Jāņa grilētu zivi un glāzi ūdens.
